title: In silico screening of TMPRSS2 SNPs that affect its binding with SARS-CoV2 spike protein and directly involved in the interaction affinity changes
authors: Fatma Nouira; Manel Hamdi; Alaeddine Redissi; Soumaya Kouidhi; Cherine Charfeddine; Meriem M’saad; Ameur Cherif; Sabri Messaoudi; Sarah Aldulaijan; Noureddine Raouafi; Adnene Dhouib; Amor Mosbah
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究TMPRSS2 SNPs对SARS-CoV2刺突蛋白结合的影响，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，且方法为常规对接模拟，与课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: In this paper, we used in silico analysis to shed light on the possible interaction between TMPRSS2 and SARS-CoV2 spike (S) protein by examining the role of TMPRSS2 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in relation with susceptibility and inter-individual variability of SARS-CoV2 infection. First, we used molecular docking of human TMPRSS2 protein to predict the binding site of TMPRSS2, especially the TMPRSS2 link loops, in order to assess the effect TMPRSS2 SNPs. The latter lead to missense variants on the interaction between TMPRSS2 and SARS-CoV2 S protein. In a second step, we further refine our analysis by performing a structure-function analysis of the complexes using PyMol software, and finally by MD simulations to validate the as-obtained results. Our findings show that 17 SNPs among the 692 natural TMPRSS2 coding variants are in positions to influence the binding of TMPRSS2 with the viral S protein. All of them give more important interaction energy as assessed by docking. Among the 17 SNPs, four missense variants E389A, K392Q, T393S and Q438E lead to “directly increasing” the interaction affinity and 2 missense variants R470I and Y416C cause it “directly decreasing”. The R470I and Y416C present in African and American population, respectively. While the other 4 SNP variants (E389A; K392Q; T393S and Q438E) are present only in the European population, which could link the viral infection susceptibility to demographic, geographic and genetic factors.
abstract_zh: 本文中，我们利用计算机模拟分析，通过考察TMPRSS2单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）在SARS-CoV2感染易感性和个体间差异中的作用，来阐明TMPRSS2与SARS-CoV2刺突（S）蛋白之间可能的相互作用。首先，我们使用人类TMPRSS2蛋白的分子对接（molecular docking）来预测TMPRSS2的结合位点，特别是TMPRSS2连接环，以评估TMPRSS2 SNPs的影响。这些SNPs导致错义变异，影响TMPRSS2与SARS-CoV2 S蛋白之间的相互作用。第二步，我们通过使用PyMol软件对复合物进行结构-功能分析，进一步细化我们的分析，最后通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟来验证所得结果。我们的发现表明，在692个天然TMPRSS2编码变异中，有17个SNPs位于可能影响TMPRSS2与病毒S蛋白结合的位置。所有这些SNPs通过对接评估均显示出更重要的相互作用能量。在这17个SNPs中，四个错义变异E389A、K392Q、T393S和Q438E导致“直接增加”相互作用亲和力，而两个错义变异R470I和Y416C则导致“直接降低”亲和力。R470I和Y416C分别存在于非洲和美洲人群中。而其他四个SNP变异（E389A；K392Q；T393S和Q438E）仅存在于欧洲人群中，这可能将病毒感染易感性与人口、地理和遗传因素联系起来。
